knowledge.statement: A node that is leader and in `Phase::Accept` advances its own accepted index as soon as it appends an entry locally; entries are replicated afterwards by `AcceptDecide`/`Accepted` and only a write-quorum of reported accepted indexes makes an index chosen (`LeaderState::is_chosen` counts accepted indexes against the accept quorum).
